Features
Priced menu, service gallery, online booking

One salon, two branches, and customers who wanted prices and a slot without calling.

We built a gallery of the salon's work, a menu with every price, a branch map, and a booking chat that saves each appointment. Customers pick a service, a date and a time in about a minute.
